title: Keith's five old photographs now line up with the model
items: Nothing you can see changed. The cameras behind five of 1808 Prairie's reference photographs (1888, 1941, 1948 and 1965) were re-fitted to the house itself, so each side-by-side now lines the model up with the picture to within a few pixels.

Lined up, the photographs show what still differs: a band of small diamond-pointed stones directly under the pierced parapet, a carved boss on the north corner, a wider corner pier, taller porch columns, and a stone strip on the south face. Those are the next building work.
